abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description: Jaina's Abilities Chill targets, Slowing them by 25% and amplifying damage taken from her Abilities by 50%. Lasts 4 seconds. Quest Deal 12,000 Spell Damage to Chilled Heroes. Unlock the Improved Ice Block ability, allowing Jaina to become temporarily Invulnerable.; trait

fields.notes: Chill can be fully removed with Invulnerable and friendly Stasis effects. Unstoppable and CC removal effects only remove the Slow and not the damage bonus debuff. All Jainas in the same team fully interact with each others' Chill debuffs regardless of who applied them in the first place. Does not stack with itself or other Chill debuffs. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Jaina's Abilities' damage.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.description: Deal 184 damage and Chill the target.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Bombard an area with 3 waves of ice, dealing 142 damage each. Damaged enemies are Chilled.

abilities.name: Ring of Frost
abilities.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.; 70; 70; heroic

fields.notes: Enemies within the inner radius are not affected in any way.

abilities.name: Summon Water Elemental
abilities.description: Summons a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62 damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental. Lasts 20 seconds. Water Elemental ; 60; 60; heroic

fields.notes: Water Elemental's Basic Attacks and Abilities on Chilled targets benefit from the damage bonus and their damage generates quest progress for Frostbite. Splash damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Improved Ice Block
abilities.description: Activate to place Jaina in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 2.5 seconds. When this effect expires, nearby enemies are Chilled. yellowtext Quest requirements must be completed before activating.; 40 / 0.5

fields.notes: Can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end the effect early. Manually exiting Improved Ice Block also causes AoE Chill to be applied.

fields.type: Bonus Mana Regeneration / Offensive damage modifier

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing Modifier, Mana
fields.notes: Spell Power stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Jaina's Spell Damage or healing output.

talents.name: Wintermute
talents.description: Increases the cast range of Water Elemental by 50%, and the Water Elemental will now mimic Jaina's Basic Abilities for 50% damage.

fields.notes: Abilities used by Water Elemental benefit from all of Jaina's Talents except Arcane Intellect, Snowstorm, and Ice Floes. Frostbolt and Cone of Cold mimicked by Water Elemental are cast after Jaina finishes her cast animation. Blizzard mimicked by Water Elemental is cast after all 3 waves of Jaina's Blizzard have fallen. Elemental casts Blizzard to the exact same area as Jaina regardless of distance. Wintermute 's damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Abilities cast by Water Elemental.

_raw_fields: Increases the cast range of Water Elemental by 50%, and the Water Elemental will now mimic Jaina's Basic Abilities for 50% damage.
